topic_summary: Analysis of competing claims to interpretive authority over the archaeological and genomic record of human origins. The physical substrate (fossils, DNA, stratigraphy) is shared, but distinct frameworks claim legitimate authority to adjudicate what that record means: credentialed scientific consensus versus religious/alternative historiographical readings. This is a contest over who possesses epistemic warrant to declare human origins truths.

key_entities: Archaeological/genomic record (fossils, DNA sequences, radiometric dates, stratigraphic layers)
Scientific consensus institutions (peer review, credentialing bodies, research universities)
Religious authority structures (scriptural interpretation traditions, theological institutions)
Alternative historiography movements (Ancient Aliens, Indigenous oral traditions, Afrocentrism)
Public education systems (curriculum standards, textbook approval processes)
key_tensions: Methodological naturalism vs supernatural causation (scientific framework excludes divine intervention; religious frameworks require it)
Credential-based authority vs revealed/traditional authority (who gets to adjudicate validity)
key_mechanisms: Peer review (gates access to legitimacy via credentialed evaluation)
Scriptural inerrancy doctrine (religious reading treats text as epistemic bedrock)
Museum/curriculum control (authority enforced via institutional display and education mandates)
key_absences: Indigenous epistemologies as distinct from 'alternative' frameworks (conflated in public discourse but structurally different authority claims)
Explicit discussion of what makes evidence 'evidence' (the prior interpretive framework that sorts signal from noise)

axes.structural_delta: Authority grounded in methodological naturalism, peer review, and replicability. Evidence must fit within materialist causation; supernatural explanations excluded by design.
axes.primary_observable: Peer-reviewed publication rates; institutional credentialing mechanisms; curriculum adoption rates
axes.selection_reason: Dominant institutional reading; high extractiveness via credentialing gatekeeping
axes.reading_commitment: The record reveals human origins through materialist processes (evolution, migration, adaptation) knowable via scientific method
axes.authority_grounding: Credential-based peer review and replicability standards
axes.expected_structural_delta: Non-credentialed interpreters excluded from legitimate discourse; high suppression of alternative causal frameworks

axes.structural_delta: Authority grounded in scriptural inerrancy or designed-universe axioms. Evidence must fit within divine causation framework; materialist timeline rejected or reinterpreted.
axes.primary_observable: Scriptural authority invocations; museum/curriculum challenges; Creation Museum attendance
axes.selection_reason: Largest alternative reading by institutional presence; structurally distinct authority grounding from naturalist reading
axes.reading_commitment: The record reveals human origins as divinely created event(s), with apparent age/fossil evidence as compatible with scriptural timeline or designed complexity
axes.authority_grounding: Scriptural inerrancy or theological inference from design arguments
axes.expected_structural_delta: Materialist timeline suppressed; divine causation required; credentialed science loses adjudicative monopoly in religious communities

axes.human_readable: Indigenous Epistemology Reading (Oral Tradition & Relational Knowledge)
axes.structural_delta: Authority grounded in sustained oral tradition, place-based knowledge, and relational epistemology. Evidence includes non-material sources (ancestral knowledge, landscape memory) excluded by both scientific and scriptural frameworks.
axes.primary_observable: Repatriation claims; consultation requirements in archaeology; recognition of Traditional Ecological Knowledge in policy
axes.selection_reason: Structurally distinct from both naturalist and creationist readings; addresses absence identified in extraction; growing institutional recognition
axes.reading_commitment: The record reveals human origins through relational continuity with ancestors and place, knowable via sustained oral tradition and ceremonial practice
axes.authority_grounding: Intergenerational transmission and community validation of oral histories
axes.expected_structural_delta: Material evidence insufficient without oral tradition; credentialed and scriptural frameworks both subordinated to community authority over ancestral remains

axes.human_readable: Alternative Historiography Reading (Ancient Aliens / Lost Civilizations)
axes.structural_delta: Authority grounded in pattern recognition outside institutional consensus, often via media platforms. Existing evidence reinterpreted as suppressed or misread by mainstream frameworks.
axes.primary_observable: Documentary viewership; online community size; Museum of Lost Civilizations proposal activity
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: lower institutional presence than creationist reading; structurally similar to creationist (rejects naturalist authority) but less coherent internal authority structure
axes.reading_commitment: The record reveals human origins as influenced by advanced ancient or extraterrestrial civilizations, suppressed by mainstream archaeology
axes.authority_grounding: Anti-institutional pattern recognition and popular media validation
axes.expected_structural_delta: Institutional archaeology framed as conspiracy; credentialing dismissed as gatekeeping

axes.structural_delta: Institutional authority enforced via public display standards and mandatory education curricula, not just peer review
axes.primary_observable: Textbook adoption battles; museum exhibit content lawsuits; state education standards
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: enforcement mechanism downstream of naturalist reading, not independent axis; captured in naturalist reading's beneficiary structure

deferred_axes.structural_delta: Ancient Aliens/Lost Civilizations reading via anti-institutional pattern recognition
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Lower institutional presence and less coherent internal authority structure than selected readings; structurally overlaps with creationist reading's rejection of naturalist authority

deferred_axes.structural_delta: Public display and education mandates as enforcement layer
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Downstream enforcement mechanism of naturalist reading; not independent axis; captured in naturalist reading's beneficiary structure and extractiveness

omegas.description: NAGPRA and similar repatriation laws grant indigenous communities veto power over research on ancestral remains. Does this make indigenous_epistemology_reading a Rope (coordination) or Snare (legal coercion)? The epsilon depends on whether consultation requirements suppress or enable research.

All three readings share the same physical substrate but sort it differently. What makes something 'evidence'? The interpretive framework precedes observation. Is this a deeper Mountain (human cognitive architecture) or itself another contested kernel?

Intelligent Design claims methodological compatibility with science (infers design from irreducible complexity) while rejecting naturalism. Does this make it a hybrid reading or a covert creationist_reading? Classification affects epsilon estimation.

Afrocentric historiography claims both anti-colonial epistemology (like indigenous_epistemology_reading) and revisionist materialism (unlike indigenous_epistemology_reading). Does it belong in alternative_historiography_reading or warrant its own axis? Structurally ambiguous.
omegas.source: Extraction absence (Indigenous epistemologies conflated with alternatives)

fracture_scan.notes: No fractures detected. Four readings identified; three selected based on institutional presence and structural distinctiveness. Deferred alternative_historiography_reading due to overlap with creationist authority rejection structure.

commitment_system_recognition.kernel_description: The archaeological and genomic record of human origins — fossils, DNA, stratigraphy, radiometric dates — treated as fixed physical substrate requiring interpretation
commitment_system_recognition.authority_description: Contested. Scientific consensus claims authority via methodological naturalism and peer review; religious frameworks via scriptural inerrancy or divine revelation; indigenous communities via sustained oral tradition and ancestral continuity.

readings.commitment: The record reveals materialist human origins (evolution, migration) knowable via scientific method
readings.authority_grounding: Credential-based peer review and replicability standards
readings.expected_structural_delta: High extractiveness via credentialing gatekeeping; supernatural causation excluded; non-credentialed interpreters suppressed

readings.commitment: The record reveals divine creation event(s) compatible with scriptural timeline or designed complexity
readings.authority_grounding: Scriptural inerrancy or theological inference from design arguments
readings.expected_structural_delta: Materialist timeline suppressed; divine causation required; credentialed science loses adjudicative monopoly in religious communities

readings.commitment: The record reveals relational continuity with ancestors and place, knowable via sustained oral tradition
readings.authority_grounding: Intergenerational transmission and community validation of oral histories
readings.expected_structural_delta: Material evidence insufficient without oral tradition; both credentialed and scriptural frameworks subordinated to community authority over ancestral remains

axiom_contradictions.basis: Methodological naturalism (supernatural causation excluded by design) cannot coexist with scriptural inerrancy (divine intervention as historical fact) in a single coherent framework. Accepting one as epistemically valid requires rejecting the other's foundational axiom.

Material evidence sufficiency (naturalist: observable phenomena alone ground truth claims) cannot coexist with relational epistemology (indigenous: truth emerges from sustained intergenerational practice and non-material sources) as equally valid warrant. One must be subordinated to the other in any single adjudicative framework.
